title: Stock Market Today Live: Stock to buy today: Coromandel International (₹1,907.45) - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: Find here all the live updates related to Sensex, Nifty, BSE, NSE, share prices and Indian stock markets for 6th November 2026.

The stock of Coromandel International has been in a bear trend for over a year. But in October, as the chart suggests, it has formed a good base at ₹1,660. By rallying about 12 per cent so far this week, the scrip has broken out of the resistance at ₹1,810 and the price is now above 21- and 50-day moving averages. Thus, the near-term trend has turned bullish. We expect the stock to rally further from the current level, surpass a notable barrier at ₹2,100 and eventually rise to ₹2,300. Therefore, traders can buy now at ₹1,907 and accumulate if the price dips to ₹1,810. Place stop-loss at ₹1,635. When the stock rallies to ₹2,080 and ₹2,220, tighten the stop-loss to ₹1,980 and ₹2,150 respectively. Book profits at ₹2,300.

(Note: The recommendations are based on technical analysis. There is a risk of loss in trading.)

ONGC reported a 25.5% year-on-year increase in consolidated revenue from operations to ₹1,98,263 crore in Q2 FY27, compared with ₹1,57,914 crore in Q2 FY26. Consolidated profit after tax (PAT) rose 46.9% to ₹18,535 crore from ₹12,615 crore, while profit before tax (PBT) increased 56.7% to ₹27,082 crore from ₹17,284 crore.

For the first half of FY27, consolidated revenue from operations grew 25.6% to ₹4,03,251 crore, compared with ₹3,21,020 crore in H1 FY26. Consolidated PAT increased 3.8% to ₹25,089 crore from ₹24,169 crore, while PBT rose 4% to ₹34,094 crore from ₹32,793 crore.

On a standalone basis, revenue from operations increased 32.8% to ₹43,875 crore in Q2 FY27, compared with ₹33,031 crore in Q2 FY26. Standalone PAT rose 57.3% to ₹15,489 crore from ₹9,848 crore, while PBT increased 57.6% to ₹19,772 crore from ₹12,545 crore.

During H1 FY27, standalone revenue from operations grew 38.9% to ₹90,336 crore from ₹65,033 crore. Standalone PAT surged 82% to ₹32,522 crore from ₹17,872 crore, while PBT increased 83% to ₹42,620 crore from ₹23,289 crore.

All figures are based on ONGC’s unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
